lfsState.strategy: mixed: preserve published ordinary Git evidence; convert every reviewed evidence-path binary introduced in origin/main..HEAD regardless of size; use LFS forward

unpublishedHistoryInfo.commandScope: refs/heads/main excluding refs/remotes/origin/main; reviewed assets, games, hub, and docs evidence-authority paths; no size threshold
unpublishedHistoryInfo.note: History occurrence counts include superseded versions across 208 unpublished commits; current-tree eligibility is the exact 723-file set above.

proposedRules.sizeGuard: No size threshold applies. A qualifying generated evidence binary must be LFS-backed or explicitly allowlisted as a reviewed regular-Git plate.
proposedRules.regularGitException: A rare intentionally selected review plate requires an explicit reviewed exemption/allowlist. No silent or size-based exemption exists.

selectionPolicy.thresholdLaw: No size threshold. Every generated evidence binary in unpublished history is reviewed for LFS conversion by path.

publishedBinaryHistoricalGit.policy: Remain ordinary historical Git because they are already reachable from origin/main.

expectedRemainingOrdinaryGitEvidencePayl.note: Payload reconciliation for the current tree. LFS pointer text created by a later migration adds small ordinary-Git records and is intentionally excluded until exact pointers exist.

sourceCheckout.cloneModel: fresh --filter=blob:none clone with non-cone sparse exclusions for evidence binaries; sparse index only if supported with the required patterns
exclude: evidence PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF binaries not approved as regular review proofs

lfsMaterialization.diagnosticFetchPolicy: selected objects only through an explicit reviewed diagnostic operation

evidenceCheckout.role: restricted evidence appliance; never an independent source workspace

volumeIdentityGuard.minimumFreeSpacePolicy: max(10 GiB, twice the projected evidence-lane payload)

localRemotes.updatePolicy: fetch plus fast-forward-only; no pull, merge, rebase, reset, force, or automatic conflict handling

lock.location: local configured state outside tracked worktrees

implementationPhases: B local configuration and helper tooling
C create and validate D evidence clone
D create and validate temporary C source partial clone
I optional old-clone removal after separate approval

sequence: create and verify external rollback bundle
create disposable migration clone at a separately approved temporary path
run migration-info and exact-path simulation in the disposable clone
rewrite only approved evidence binaries in origin/main..HEAD
prove origin/main remains unchanged and reachable
validate every rewritten commit, pointer, and required LFS object
run complete repository tests, builds, and validators
seed future C and D checkouts from the proven rewritten branch
retain original C clone and rollback artifacts until post-cutover approval

rehearsalInterruptions: D disconnected after commit but before return
evidence commit sealed but not returned

historicalSplitPublicationAuthority.dAuthority: May upload only exact reviewed LFS OIDs for the active sealed evidence commit through a guarded helper.

activeEvidencePolicy.existingEvidence: Grandfathered in ordinary Git at existing paths.
activeEvidencePolicy.futureHeavyEvidence: External durable D storage by default.
trackedLightweightAuthority: selected compact review stills or contact sheets
